Subject: Supplier enrollment: invoice submission & sample rows

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — excited to start the onboarding. A couple quick questions as we get set up on your side:

1) Do you require invoices to be uploaded through the vendor portal as the primary method, or can we submit by email as a backstop? If portal-first, is there a grace period where email is accepted?

2) Can you share a minimal sample row layout (CSV column headers) you prefer for PO-backed invoices? We want to align our billing system to avoid rejections.

3) Any special PO-stamping requirement (e.g., must include Redwood PO number in both filename and invoice body)?

We can fill any enrollment form you have — happy to return a sample invoice.

Thanks,
Samantha Rivera
Finance Ops 
Papertrail Supplies
accounts@papertrailsupplies.com
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Rivera <samantha@papertrailsupplies.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-17T09:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment: invoice submission & sample rows

Hi Samantha — thanks for reaching out. Short answers up front: portal-first, email OK as a short-term backstop; PO number required in the invoice body and subject token helps with routing. Details below and next steps.

Portal vs email:
- Preferred: vendor portal (enrollment link below). Portal gives immediate acks, automated PO-match and faster payment cycles.
- Backstop: invoices sent to accounts@papertrailsupplies.com will be ingested for 30 days post-golive while portal enrollment finishes, but we ask teams to move to portal after that.

Minimal sample CSV headers we use for PO-backed invoices (please match column names exactly):
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- po_number
- vendor_name
- line_description
- quantity
- unit_price
- currency (ISO 4217)
- tax_amount
- total_amount
- remittance_account

PO-stamping rules:
- Include Redwood PO (exact token) in both the invoice body and the filename. Subject token is optional but recommended (e.g., REDWOOD-PO-<po_number>).

Attachments & enrollment form:
- I attached our supplier_onboarding_form.pdf — please complete and return. Once we receive it we’ll provision portal access and send a test PO to validate your CSV mapping.

Next steps:
1) Complete supplier_onboarding_form.pdf and return to me.
2) Send a test invoice (CSV) using the headers above to accounts@papertrailsupplies.com with subject REDWOOD-PO-<po>.
3) We’ll validate and flip portal on for you.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference

Hi Samantha — got both the enrollment form and the sample CSV. Quick notes from validation:
- CSV headers match, but tax_amount must be numeric (no %). We fixed one of the rows during intake and will show the corrected mapping in the portal test screen.
- We provisioned your portal account this morning (you should receive an invite shortly). After you accept, upload the same sample CSV through the portal test upload to confirm mapping.

Temporary email-backstop remains available until 2025-12-17. After that all active vendors must use the portal for PO-backed invoices. If you need earlier onboarding assistance, Vanessa can run a quick test call this week.

Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Best,
